release_notes: Fixed: creating a local or action landing failed with a NOT NULL constraint violation on the url column when the caller did not send a URL — which both those landing types legitimately have none. The url field now defaults to an empty string instead of null, so the MCP tools, the old quick form and the new stream modal all save cleanly. Behind this, the stream's landing create/edit modal (v0.9.6.6) is unchanged.
